== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The Shield [[Icon]] is a specialized connection available to [[Heralds]] that provides defensive capabilities. Represented by a symbol resembling a shining blue wall or a castle, the [[Icon]] radiates an [[aura]] of [[Authority|authority]] and offers protection that can feel like a [[safe]] haven. Its defensive properties range from absolute barriers capable of isolating portions of the world or resisting spatial [[destruction]] to more versatile, smaller planes used for deflecting, redirecting, or attacking. While the [[Icon]] can be layered onto a [[Herald]]'s body for added durability, its effectiveness is tied to the user's abilities and experience; a newly awakened [[Herald]] may have limited reach, but they can expand the [[Icon]]'s influence over time. The connection manifests as a constant musical presence in the user's mind, which can increase in intensity. Beyond simple defense, the [[Icon]]'s protection can function by either keeping external forces out or containing forces within.}}

== Waybound ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The Shield [[Icon]] first emitted a discordant note before providing protection to [[Yerin]] while [[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]] listened to its song. Although it possesses no inherent connection to spatial [[Authority|authority]], [[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]] clung to the icon as it sang within his heart. The entity approved of a death intended to protect others and extended its hardiness to cover [[Mercy]]. Ultimately, the Shield [[Icon]] reinforced barriers for [[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]] and prevented his [[destruction]] during a fight with his [[Remnant]].}}

== Threshold: Stories from Cradle ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The Shield [[Icon]] emits a continuous singing sound that remains a constant presence within Ziel of the Wasteland{{!}}Ziel's mind. This song gradually increases in volume, much to the annoyance of [[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]]. Beyond its auditory effects, the protection offered by the Shield [[Icon]] can be utilized to keep forces locked in.}}
